items.title: Make finding clustering available wherever DEV findings are actionable
items.context: DEV currently permits finding_add, review_pass_set, finding_dispatch, and dispatch, but rejects finding_cluster. The hard-coded phase whitelist should allow clustering before dispatching grouped finding fixes without weakening gate evidence.
items.userSees: In a DEV story with open reviewer findings, koala finding_cluster {"storyId":"B-xxxx"} is accepted by the phase gate and prints a normal cluster result instead of the DEV-stage unavailable-command error.

happy.desc: Default phaseTools allow finding_cluster in DEV

edge.desc: REVIEW and TEST still allow finding_cluster after the change

adversarial.desc: Custom project phaseTools continue to override defaults and can still block finding_cluster if the project intentionally removes it

verificationEvidence.note: After contract hardening commit, local built CLI in DEV accepted finding_cluster and returned a cluster summary instead of the DEV unavailable-command error.
Flow stability smoke asserts finding_cluster remains allowed in REVIEW and TEST after the DEV whitelist addition.
Flow stability smoke asserts custom phaseTools can still block finding_cluster when a project explicitly overrides defaults.

items.title: Add regression coverage for finding phase-tool consistency
items.context: Add a focused smoke/contract assertion that if DEV can record findings and dispatch finding fixes, it can also run finding_cluster; this catches the SimCell B-cacf failure mode.
items.userSees: In a DEV story like SimCell B-cacf, running koala finding_cluster {"storyId":"B-xxxx"} no longer prints "命令 finding_cluster 在 DEV 阶段不可用"; it returns a cluster summary or a no-findings message, so the user can dispatch grouped fixes.

happy.desc: DEV phase allows finding_cluster alongside finding_add/finding_dispatch so reviewer findings can be grouped before fix dispatch

edge.desc: Only the intended finding_cluster command is newly available in DEV; unrelated gated commands such as bug_report remain blocked

adversarial.desc: Contract checks fail if a future phaseTools change again allows finding_add/finding_dispatch in DEV but removes finding_cluster

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts DEV allows finding_add, finding_dispatch, and finding_cluster together for reviewer finding workflows.
Command failed as expected with DEV-stage unavailable-command error, proving unrelated bug_report stayed blocked.
Process-fact contract now parses DEV phaseTools string-literal entries, asserts finding_cluster stays L2, and keeps finding_add/finding_dispatch/finding_cluster together.

auditLog.reason: Implement minimal DEV phaseTools change and targeted assertions.
Add regression coverage for DEV finding_cluster phase-tools consistency.
DEV phaseTools now allow finding_cluster; build and local CLI evidence recorded.
Flow stability smoke and process-fact contract cover SimCell DEV cluster regression and negative boundary.
